title: Fire Department access to equipment.
officialText:
Rooms or areas containing controls for air-conditioning systems, automatic fire-
extinguishing systems or other detection, suppression or control elements shall be identified for use by the Fire Department.
SECTION BC 403
HIGH-RISE BUILDINGS
